dedupeResult: The complete open PR patch was searched for each official name and canonical domain or demo mailbox. No prior GoodBrother, SubCulture Recordings or NexGen Music Group submission-agent record was found. Each opportunity is stored once; playlist pages, general-contact addresses, licensing pages, newsletter routes and duplicate form/email representations are consolidated or excluded.
emailVerificationLevel: demo@goodbrother.io, demos@subculture050.com and demos@nexgenmusicgroup.com are first-party published, syntactically valid and explicitly authorized for demos. info@goodbrother.io, info@subculture050.com, info@nexgen.music and info@nexgenmusicgroup.com are first-party general, privacy or terms contacts and are not treated as replacement submission routes. The NexGen demo mailbox uses the legacy official nexgenmusicgroup.com domain while the current site uses nexgen.music; the official current demo page directly publishes it. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: All three canonical routes are official public first-party pages. GoodBrother requests a finished unreleased electronic track through a private SoundCloud link and a label-signing acknowledgement. SubCulture requests a downloadable private SoundCloud playlist, prefers 6 to 10 tracks and offers an authorized demo-email alternative; the embedded fields were not exposed and its privacy policy contains incomplete retention placeholders. NexGen offers a 300MB upload form or authorized email route, requests at least four high-quality unreleased tracks and imposes age, licence, warranty and indemnity terms. No field, upload, link, email, acknowledgement, terms, CAPTCHA, payment or submit action was exercised.
safety: No email was sent, no form field was filled, no private music or playlist link was shared, no audio file was uploaded, no acknowledgement or terms were accepted, no CAPTCHA or hidden anti-spam control was tested, no payment was used and no submission, authentication or platform restriction was bypassed.
